propositions: A Jira issue's key changes when moved between projects, but its numeric id remains immutable; bindings keyed on the mutable key silently detach when third-party movers fail to update the moved_issue_key table.
The binding store must record the numeric id alongside the key and fall back to id-based lookup when a key lookup fails, re-keying the binding to the issue's current key on a cache hit.
The absence probe must retry by recorded id before concluding an issue is absent, to prevent silent retirement of live issues whose old key is no longer resolvable.
The fallback mechanism must not fire on the happy path when the key resolves normally, to avoid doubling the cost of absence probes.
The fix must be additive to preserve Cloud vendor behavior and avoid rewriting the shared store identity and reverse index.
Legacy bindings without a recorded id must continue to work unchanged, with no migration required.
